zh: 星宇航空9月營收年增69%，客運與貨運均成長。
en: Starlux Airlines reports September revenue up 69% year on year.

zh: 漢莎航空波音747-8於洛杉磯機場放棄降落，險些擦尾，延誤近半小時落地。
en: Lufthansa Boeing 747-8 aborts landing at LAX, narrowly avoiding a tail strike; touched down about half an hour late.

zh: 希斯洛機場稱逾40家航空公司尋求時刻
en: Heathrow says over 40 airlines seek slots

zh: 空中巴士U740 Valkyrie在歐洲完成首次飛行
en: Airbus U740 Valkyrie completes first flight in Europe

zh: Avolon訂購250架飛機，仍待股東批准
en: Avolon orders 250 aircraft, pending shareholder approval.

zh: 美軍沙漠演習測試無人機，伺服器過熱且電池無法充電
en: US Army drone trials faced overheated servers and batteries that could not be recharged.

zh: 童子瑋提出基隆捷運市區共構及安樂線延伸構想
en: Keelung candidate 童子瑋 proposes a two-line metro concept.

zh: Eliance申請初步債權人保護，未來取決於債權人協商。
en: Eliance files for preliminary creditor protection; its future depends on creditor talks.

zh: 印度A321neo客機乘客應對頭頂行李櫃行動電源起火，航班改道
en: Passengers battle a power bank fire aboard an Indian A321neo; the aircraft diverts.

zh: 航空業高層稱嚴格篩檢仍無法完全防範駕駛艙內部威脅
en: Airline chiefs say screening cannot fully prevent cockpit insider threats.
